author: Nerdstalgic
description:
When The Big Bang Theory first premiered, it looked VERY different from the sitcom that would eventually become one of television’s biggest hits.

Over its 11 season run, the series made some major changes to its characters, relationships, and overall formula. From introducing new characters who helped solve the show’s biggest problems, to reworking its original premise into something far more familiar, The Big Bang Theory was constantly evolving behind the scenes.

But were these changes always part of the plan? Why did the show need to reinvent itself? And after more than a decade on the air, why did The Big Bang Theory ultimately have to come to an end?

title: How The Big Bang Theory Fixed Its Biggest Problems | Compilation
